stages.task: Basic-engineering basis, no P&ID XML yet: (a) DESIGN.md decisions D-013 onward for the fermentation area as the specification lists (seed train with its schedule arithmetic and number of trains, continuous steriliser parts and the fill-rate decision, production fermenter design R-201A..P: agitator, jacket, pH by milk-of-lime ring main, no aeration with the reason, N2 overlay or sterile vent, sterile filter, relief and vacuum protection, steam blocks and the sterile boundary, CIP station and SIP steam, harvest and broth hold; the sheet split; tag and line-numbering conventions), and the SRC-1 facts of the specification added to the source register; (b) equipment/equipment-list.yaml: R-201 split into R-201A to R-201P, the seed fermenters, CIP station items, tanks, pumps, filters, the steriliser's parts, and the downstream items basic engineering needs (pumps, drums, reboilers, condensers, vacuum systems), each with type, service, sheet, design pressure/temperature, material and dimensions (diameter/height or length/width/height, ASSUMED where not sourced) so the layout can use them; (c) plant.yaml: stage basic and every sheet of the specification declared status planned; (d) first line list entries for the fermentation-area lines (number, from, to, DN with the basis) and the instrument list for P-101 to P-204 as far as decided; (e) the plot plan for gate layout-plot-plan (layout/site-plan.yaml with site, areas, roads, racks and separations; layout/equipment-placement.yaml with every equipment-list item placed; skill layout-yaml). Run cheme validate (planned sheets hold back not-on-pid findings) and cheme check; commit in logical pieces.

Draw P-101 (medium preparation and continuous sterilisation: syrup and CSL tanks, V-101, E-101 as regenerative exchanger, steam heater, holding tube, back-pressure valve, divert to V-101 on low holding temperature, sterile medium header to the seed train and the fermenters) and then P-102 (quicklime silo and feeder, slaker R-101 with its cooling, milk-of-lime tank and the circulating ring main with its pumps to the seed and production fermenters). Render each sheet (cheme render --png, crops of dense parts) and LOOK at it before committing; keep the equipment, line and instrument lists in step (skill lists-sync); commit each sheet when it validates.

Draw P-201, the seed train (plant stages 3 to 5 of every train as decided in DESIGN.md, the lab stages 1 and 2 as a note; each seed fermenter agitated and jacketed with temperature, pH, level and pressure, sterile vent filter, steam blocks on the medium, base and transfer connections, CIP and SIP connections, sterile transfer to the next stage and to the production fermenter inoculum header). The sheet is A3: draw train A in full and readable; if three trains do not fit legibly, put trains B and C as typicals of train A on a further sheet (e.g. P-205, plant.yaml and lists updated, D-028's sheet-split record extended). Use a generator script or cheme copy for the repeated trains. Do the FIX FIRST items marked 'before P-201' and the quick P-102/P-103 fixes first, briefly. Render each sheet (cheme render --png, crops of dense parts) and LOOK at it before committing; keep the equipment, line and instrument lists in step (skill lists-sync); commit each sheet when it validates.

Draw P-202, production fermenter R-201A in full detail as the typical one, everything item 3 of the specification lists (agitator and seal, jacket on tempered cooling water with the temperature loop, pH loop with two probes and the milk-of-lime dosing branch with flush, radar level, headspace pressure with vent back-pressure valve, steam-sterilisable vent filter, relief for the SIP steam case, vacuum protection, N2 overlay or sterile vent per DESIGN.md, note: no aeration (anaerobic), aseptic sampling valve, steam blocks on medium and inoculum inlets, harvest valve, CIP spray supply and return, SIP steam inlets and condensate traps, sterile boundary marked). Make it readable at slide size: one vessel large in the middle, loops clearly drawn. Render each sheet (cheme render --png, crops of dense parts) and LOOK at it before committing; keep the equipment, line and instrument lists in step (skill lists-sync); commit each sheet when it validates. Of the FIX FIRST list do only what P-202 needs (S1#3 SIP in the turnaround, S1#4 vacuum case and vent-filter protection, S1#7 tempered-water heating, S2#9 the lime-dosing sterile boundary, steam blocks on CIP inlets as S2#1/S3#5 ask, high-level protection, aseptic sampling, and the C&E entries of R-201A's trips) and design R-201A so the seed-train findings do not repeat there; leave the other carry-over items (P-201, P-102, P-103 drawing fixes) to the close-out stage S9.

Draw P-203 (production fermenters R-201B to R-201P as typicals of R-201A on the common headers: sterile medium, inoculum, milk-of-lime ring main, CIP supply and return, SIP steam, vent; the harvest header and pumps, broth hold tank T-201 agitated and kept warm, feed pumps to the centrifuges; a generator script with a loop over the 15 fermenters is the efficient way) and then P-204 (CIP station: caustic, acid if decided, water and recovered-rinse tanks, supply pump, LP-steam heater, return pump, conductivity and temperature on the return, supply and return headers to the fermentation area; SIP steam: filtered LP steam header, condensate). Render each sheet (cheme render --png, crops of dense parts) and LOOK at it before committing; keep the equipment, line and instrument lists in step (skill lists-sync); commit each sheet when it validates. Also draw P-205 (seed trains B and C as typicals of train A on P-201, a generator script; first bring train A on P-201 up to the S3 review's findings S3#1 to S3#5 so the typicals copy a corrected train). Order: P-203, P-205, P-204; if the budget runs short, leave P-204 for the next stage.

Draw P-301 (cell removal S-301 machines in parallel with their feed and cake handling, acidulation R-301 with the 93 wt% acid dosing on ratio/pH and its cooling sized on D-007, gypsum belt filter S-302 with vacuum system, filtrate receiver and pumps, gypsum cake discharge) and then P-401 (four-effect evaporator E-401 with effects, separators, condenser, vacuum system, condensate and pumps). Render each sheet (cheme render --png, crops of dense parts) and LOOK at it before committing; keep the equipment, line and instrument lists in step (skill lists-sync); commit each sheet when it validates.

Draw P-402 (esterification R-401 by reactive distillation with ethanol feed, ester column C-401 under vacuum with reboiler on MP steam, condenser, reflux drum, vacuum system, residue cooler and pump) and then P-403 (ethanol column C-402, hydrolysis R-402, stripper C-403, product concentrator E-404, product cooler E-405, product tank and pumps, ethanol recycle and make-up). Render each sheet (cheme render --png, crops of dense parts) and LOOK at it before committing; keep the equipment, line and instrument lists in step (skill lists-sync); commit each sheet when it validates.

3D layout for gate layout-3d (skills layout-yaml, structures-access, pipe-routing, area-classification): building.yaml and structures.yaml (production fermenters in two rows with the top access structure and the rack between them, or a fermentation hall, as DESIGN.md decides; the clad seed/media/CIP building; downstream structures for columns and evaporators; tank farm), equipment-placement.yaml updated (every item placed, elevated items mounted on levels, sensible spacing for maintenance and the separations), piping/routing.yaml with racks and tiers, zones.yaml (ethanol and solvent areas, keep-clear, laydown, escape), then cheme layout build, cheme layout route / report; fix clashes and headroom findings or accept them with a reason in checks/checks.yaml; render the plot plan and at least two sections (one through the fermenter rows) with cheme layout render --png and LOOK at them; run cheme layout lifting --write and cheme assess mto --write; commit layout/plant-model.yaml. Record the layout decisions in DESIGN.md.

Close-out: fix every open review finding; control/loops.yaml for the fermentation-area loops (fermenter temperature, pH, level, pressure; steriliser temperature and divert; seed fermenters; ring main), control/cause-effect.yaml with the trips, the instrument list in step with the sheets; a HAZOP study draft of the production fermenter and the steriliser (safety/hazop, skill hazop-study, everything status proposed, no bands written by hand); process-basic gate (accept the component-balance infos only with a reason, or fix them); bring validate to 0 errors and the fewest warnings; make every basic gate ok or explain why not in DESIGN.md; update README.md (stage, sheets, key numbers) and PROGRESS.md. Do not sign off.
